# WWD

> > WWD (Women's Wear Daily) is the leading fashion industry trade publication covering business news, designer collections, celebrity style, footwear trends, beauty industry developments, and executive appointments.

WWD provides comprehensive coverage of the global fashion ecosystem, from runway analysis and red carpet coverage to C-suite moves, legal issues, brand acquisitions, and retail strategies. The publication tracks major luxury houses like Gucci and Lanvin, footwear giants, and emerging brands while documenting celebrity fashion moments and industry trends.

## Key Topics

- Luxury Fashion Business
- Designer Collections & Runway Analysis
- Celebrity Red Carpet Style
- Footwear Industry News
- Executive Appointments & Leadership
- Brand Acquisitions & Investments
- Retail Strategy & Store Operations
- Beauty Industry Partnerships
- Fashion Fraud & Legal Issues
- Fall 2026 Trends
- Gucci & Demna
- Lanvin Leadership
- Marquee Brands & Roberto Cavalli
- Awards Show Fashion
- Sustainable Fashion & Innovation
